Meals: Two meals a day, aiming for a 2:1 fat-to-protein ratio. Between 6:00 and 8:00 AM, I eat 250g of beef or lamb. Between 1:00 and 3:00 PM, I eat 4-6 eggs cooked with animal fat (keeping the 2:1 ratio) or 250g of sardines fried in butter or ghee. no food after 3-4 PM, and no drinks after 5PM, sleeping time around 8-9 PM.
Snacks: 50-100g of walnuts, almonds, or pumpkin seeds. an Avocado or two 2-3 times weekly.
Spices/Seasonings: Sea salt, pepper, and occasionally pickled jalapeños. I also mix one smashed garlic clove with extra virgin olive oil into my second meal.
Drinks: 7-stage filtered water with a pinch of salt added to a one-liter bottle (drunk only when I feel thirsty).  2-3 cups of brewed black coffee (diluted with plenty of hot water) and occasionally 1-2 cups of green tea. Once in a while, I drink 1-2 teaspoons of pure cacao powder with hot water only.
Workout PRG: I walk about 10 minutes after each meal , do HIIT 2-3 times per week. My weightlifting routine includes dumbbell workouts for both the upper and lower body. Three times a week, I do push-ups (around 60 reps per set, 2-3 sets weekly), pull-ups 8-12 reps  (6-9 sets weekly), and dips 10-20 reps per set 6-9 sets per week).

The Problem:

After getting a C-Peptide test and finding it on the lower end, along with all the other numbers in my blood work, like the fasting insulin being below 2, I began to suspect that I am Type 1.5 (LADA) and not Type 2 as I was originally diagnosed.
